sloka: तत्र प्राक् ज्योतिषम् नाम जातरूपमयम् पुरम् ।यस्मिन् वसति दुष्ट आत्मा नरको नाम दानवः ॥४-४२-३१॥
transliteration: tatra prāk jyotiṣam nāma jātarūpamayam puram ।yasmin vasati duṣṭa ātmā narako nāma dānavaḥ ॥4-42-31॥

translations.english: 'On the (Varaha) mountain is the city called Pragjyotisha, which is full of gold.There lives the evilminded demon Naraka.
